verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com and Markdown versions of doc pages, including an Agents guide (agents.md) that links back to the llms.txt index. An agent can therefore be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, these probes cover OpenAI's general developer hub rather than the SDK's own docs site at openai.github.io. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms.txt or Markdown docs on the SDK-specific documentation site, confirmation that the llms.txt index covers SDK API reference content, and first-party docs describing the agent-oriented docs offering.
